says: The wiki brought to what stands: its briefs on the store, the client and the interface rewritten, their stale marks resolved
A sixth session, kept whole: the code brought to the store, and a language for the engine and a store for each module asked after
A ground in References live in bodies said again: a $ pattern in rewrite.ts had taken up the text around its own codespan, and the tool now takes its replacement as a function
The fourth to sixth sessions measured, in the voice of a seventh held under Sessions; the second session's note said anew, its packs and counted names having given way to blocks
The store's 50 types held by a whole made for them, so a type stands in the holarchy rather than beside it at the top

The wiki brought to what stands after the seventh session's work: a way of looking seen at its level with Flat to see all of it and no grouping chosen for one, types and glass's pieces held by wholes, the root giving what is attached, kept in the home, the page naming the entry and everything else reached from it by reference, and the address bare at the root

A seventh session, kept whole: the field seen by its levels, the glue carved, and expressions taken down to a kernel of facts: all twenty-seven of the author's utterances, seven paths noted, and ten marks on what is not to be forgotten

The seventh session's essence beside the author's words: ten condensed answers in its own voice, one after each arc, each with a condensation saying the fuller answer was not kept; the author's last two utterances, a path on an index apart from the engine, a thread on order among facts raised in the author's words, and a mark on the structure they named
A path said anew at the author's word: indexing belongs to each store's integration, which answers patterns or brings its own language, and not to the engine nor a layer coupled to it

The seventh session ended at the author's word: their last three utterances with the essence of the answers between them, The plan from here as its first path for the next session to begin at, the order thread said anew with the session's lean that order lives in values, and a mark
The seventh session's day said as one date, the day it began, its span said in what was kept
